title: Activity Participation Waiver
description: Please complete this waiver before taking part. If the participant is under 18, a parent or legal guardian must complete and sign it.

elements.name: activityDate
elements.title: Activity date
elements.description: For a series or season, enter the first date.

elements.name: participantEmail
elements.title: Email
elements.description: For a participant under 18, a parent's email is fine.

elements.name: guardianDetails
elements.title: Parent or legal guardian
elements.description: The participant is under 18, so a parent or legal guardian must complete this section and sign the waiver.

elements.title: Emergency contact

elements.title: Does the participant have any medical conditions, allergies, or physical limitations we should know about?

elements.title: Please describe them and any care staff should provide

elements.name: waiverText
elements.html:
Assumption of risk and release

Taking part in this activity involves risks that cannot be completely removed, even with careful supervision and well-maintained equipment. These risks include, among others, slips and falls, collisions with people or objects, equipment failure, changing weather and ground conditions, physical strain and exhaustion, and the actions of other participants. They can lead to property damage, serious injury, or, in rare cases, death.

By signing below, the participant (or, for a participant under 18, the parent or legal guardian) agrees to take part voluntarily and accepts these risks. To the fullest extent permitted by law, the signer releases the organizer, its staff, volunteers, and agents from claims arising from participation, except claims caused by their gross negligence or willful misconduct.

The participant agrees to follow staff instructions and safety rules, use equipment as directed, and stop taking part if they feel unwell or unsafe.

choices.text: I have read this waiver and understand the risks of the activity.
The participant is taking part voluntarily and is physically able to do so.
The participant will follow staff instructions, safety rules, and equipment guidelines.
I authorize the organizer to arrange emergency medical treatment for the participant if needed, at the participant's own expense.
I agree to the release of claims described above.

validators.text: Please confirm every statement to continue.

elements.name: guardianConsent
elements.title: I am the participant's parent or legal guardian, and I agree to this waiver on their behalf

validators.text: A parent or legal guardian must agree for a participant under 18 to take part.

elements.name: mediaConsent
elements.title: May the organizer use photos or video in which the participant appears for promotional purposes?
elements.description: Optional. Your answer does not affect participation.

elements.name: signerFullName
elements.title: Full name of the person signing
elements.description: The participant, or the parent or legal guardian if the participant is under 18.
